messages:
alex (docs): Quick sync: noticed the cost/latency breakdown example in console/guide/costs.md shows an old metric name (request.lat_ms) that doesn't exist in new telemetry. Users get 0 values.
nora (obs): good catch. The runtime now emits latency_ms and token_cost_cents. docs should use latency_ms and show cost = token_cost_cents / 100.
paul (eng): upstream was intentionally changed during telemetry v2 cutover. We kept a compat shim for a month but removed it. docs should warn about migration.
alex (docs): I'll update the snippet and add a migration note with a minimal PromQL example: sum(rate(latency_ms_bucket[5m])) by (route). Also add a note about units (ms vs s).
paul (eng): can you also add the mapping table: request.lat_ms -> latency_ms, request.cost_usd -> token_cost_cents/100. I'll paste a small JSON-to-YAML mapping to include.
nora (obs): small UX nit: the dashboard example used a heatmap with linear scale; recommend log scale for wide tail latencies. Document that as an optional toggle.
ci-bot: running docs linkcheck for PR 3901... 1 warning: example query references metrics.v1 namespace.
alex (docs): thanks, fixing names and pushing PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3901. Adding unit tests that render the snippet and assert it returns non-zero sample data in the mock telemetry harness.
paul (eng): once CI passes, can we backport to release-1.2 branch? Lots of customers on older console images who hit confusion.
alex (docs): will do. Also added a tiny Python snippet showing cost calc: cost_cents = row['token_cost_cents']; cost_usd = cost_cents / 100.
nora (obs): LGTM. Thanks for moving fast on this, customers will appreciate the clarity. :tada:
